name: Nigeria

children.text: WAEC, NECO and SSCE results are recognised routes, subject to denklik. Where a student holds results from more than one sitting, the combination needs handling carefully, and it is worth raising early rather than at submission.

Denklik is the Turkish recognition of a foreign secondary qualification, and it is the step most likely to delay a Nigerian application. It runs alongside the university application rather than after it.
Certificates are authenticated in Nigeria before submission in Türkiye. Where results come from multiple sittings, expect additional scrutiny.

denklikTimingNote: Denklik typically takes several weeks, and the range is wide. Applications with results from more than one sitting generally take longer than single-sitting applications.

authenticationOffice.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
authenticationOffice.process: Certificates and transcripts are authenticated before submission. Confirm the current document list directly, as requirements are revised periodically.
authenticationOffice.timingNote: Turnaround varies considerably. Allow substantially more time than the minimum quoted at the counter.

turkishEmbassy.appointmentNotes: Student visa appointments are booked in advance and become scarce ahead of the September intake. Book as soon as the acceptance letter is issued.

children.text: Lagos and Abuja both have connections to Istanbul, with onward domestic connections within Türkiye. Fares vary widely by season and booking lead time.
